title: AgentNode
description: The durable Port Daddy record for an agent (binder README, ch09 agent_nodes). Binds identity, class, authority, compliance level, current session and body, and policy. An Agent Node exists before the first model turn; a body cannot self-upgrade compliance.

complianceLevel.description: Frozen 7-level ladder (ADR-0095 fork resolution 2): C0 Registered, C1 Transcripted, C2 Governed, C3 Suggestible, C4 Controllable, C5 Cooperative, C6 Resumable. Daemon-witnessed only; never self-attested. Any value above C0 MUST be backed by complianceProbeId whose ComplianceProbeResult.witnessedLevel is >= this level (ADR-0095 §8 witnessing invariant, enforced by compliance-invariants.mjs); an unbacked level is self-report and invalid.

complianceProbeId.description: The ComplianceProbeResult that witnesses complianceLevel. Mandatory (non-null) whenever complianceLevel > C0; the daemon must not grant a level this node's latest probe did not earn.

transcriptFidelity.description: T0 inventory, T1 run log, T2 visible chat, T3 tool-backed, T4 verified (minimum for official C1), T5 resumable (required for C6).

officialMode.description: Honest downgraded modes per the control-plane synthesis packet.

articlesSignature.description: Signed Articles of Agreement reference; issued by the daemon, never self-declared.

profile.description: Optional operator-authored durable roster profile. The AgentNode id remains the canonical principal; profile.slug is only a human alias.
